items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Me and my brother, and Lil Jim played with Eddie Pearson, well he was playing bass, you understand?

ctx.x: We were at the Young Morgan band at the time then. Before Sam took the band in charge. Young Morgan band. Me and my brother, and Lil Jim played with Eddie Pearson, well he was playing bass, you understand?
And who would Effie play with?
